rule: Once you join a faction, gain a new Mission by visiting their Settlement Headquarters. Completing a Mission gives +1 Favor, 3 EXP, and a random reward. Roll a d10 for each element of the Mission table.

objectives.objective: Spread sympathy for the cause. Hang propaganda posters and install a radio antenna for W.A.R.G. broadcasts.
Attack a Shell-4 Transporter carrying supplies for an ISF outpost. [-1 Favor]
Destroy an outlaw Epsilon Interceptor ship looting and terrorizing defenseless civilian vessels.
Strike back at a Medusa Sector base storing stolen W.A.R.G. data. Fight 2 Nettheckers. [-1 Favor]
Infiltrate a large industrial weapon manufacturing facility and steal weapons and resources for the cause.
Fabricate explosives with materials from a secret stash. Gain random grenades in your TEC slot.
Take over a crucial ISF outpost at a key strategic spot. Fight an ISF Sentinel. [-1 Favor]
Help workers protect their starship from a bounty hunter. Destroy a Starspreader. [+1 Favor]
Attack a renowned mercenary group hired to fight against W.A.R.G. Eliminate 2 Mercenaries.
Plant a powerful explosive at an oil refinery station and escape without a trace.

cargo.cargo: Fugitive from a high-security prison, cuffed and restrained. Must be transferred to ISF forces.
Expensive aged liquor predating the Old World, fragile.
Cylindrical orange container with radioactive materials from a Nucleus Moon.
Large boxes of soil from a terraformed planet for geological study.
A repaired satellite ready to be set in orbit again.
Food and supplies for an ISF counter-terrorism squadron.
Heavy metallic boxes with powerful computer terminals from a derelict space station.
Metal safe with thousands of digital Serum codes for Trade Authority contractors.
Newly manufactured weapons and armor for mercenary recruits.
Crew of an ISF cargo ship rescued from space pirates. Gain +1 Action Die during space combat until mission ends.

complications.complication: A Starpredator fires missiles at your vessel.
ROLL VIGOR - Failure = Lose 5 Energy. Cargo damaged.
2 Dust Wasps attack in the cargo bay.
Navigation glitch. ROLL MIND - Failure = Lose 5 Hull. Cargo damaged.
3 Vector Ace Fighters attack - coordinated W.A.R.G. attack.
A nest of space flies in the cargo hold.
Explosive found in cargo. ROLL TECH - Failure = Lose 8 Health. Cargo damaged.
A Snowstorm Delta bounty hunter attacks to steal cargo.
Asteroid field crossing. ROLL GRACE - Failure = Lose 5 Hull. Cargo damaged.
3 Looters infiltrate and attack from inside.

data.objective: Install coordinate tracking software on an ISF terminal to track all enemy ships.
Upload a replicating worm virus to a low-orbit satellite to reveal a hidden planet.
Enter an abandoned cloud computer terminal and backup all data to a Medusa server.
Infiltrate a cybertech harvesting plant and install a virus on the power generator.
Install a trojan on a starship's auto-pilot to gain complete navigation control.
Find a relay signal emitter used by smugglers and install an ISF tracking device on it.
Use a digital key to decrypt a message in a criminal's quantum computer.
Transport a data shard with cryptovirology research and upload it to a safe terminal.
Install a logic bomb virus on a terminal used to trade stolen starship parts.
Download terminal data containing the location of a hidden W.A.R.G. Settlement (2 tiles south).

complications.complication: A paranoid Scientist tries to stab you.
Encrypted terminal. ROLL MIND - Failure = Lose 3 Energy. Terminal inaccessible.
Synth Arch Android Titan guards the terminal. [-1 Favor]
Power malfunction. ROLL TECH - Failure = Lose 4 Energy. Terminal inaccessible.
Security alarm triggers; 2 Automaton Bots attack.
Outlaw Ranger attacks in Ambush.
Antivirus must be deactivated. ROLL MIND - Failure = Lose 4 Energy. Terminal inaccessible.
Alien creature has turned the computer room into its lair. Eliminate a Deepworm.
Motherboard glitches. ROLL TECH - Failure = Lose 3 Energy. Terminal inaccessible.
Surrounded by 3 ISF Soldiers with a warrant for your arrest. Fight or abandon the mission.

target.target: An ISF Trade Baron who established a trade route through pirate territory. [-2 Favor]
A Calosian general accused of unspecified war crimes.
An Android Titan attacking a W.A.R.G. recon group. [-2 Favor]
A Synth Apostle accused of manipulation and selling Synth Arch secrets.
A gifted Memory Hacker cracking a restricted cyberspace sector with illegal trades.
A Cyborg with stolen cybertech implants - the owner wants them repossessed.
A Cyber-Terrorist who left dozens of civilians crippled through cyberattacks.
A Bounty Hunter - kill them and return your Bounty Mark to your client.
An Outer Ring Crime Boss in the drug trafficking business.

complications.complication: Target calls for reinforcements - a Bullseye Hunter appears.
Target wrestles you down. ROLL VIGOR - Failure = Take 8d+GRA damage, ignoring Armor.
A Voidcrawler is startled by the fight and turns hostile. Fight both simultaneously.
Target tries to inject a NOFTML Key. ROLL MIND - Failure = MIN set to 0 for the rest of the fight.
Target uses a hidden Health Pack, restoring d10+TEC Health.
Target injects stim-boosters: +1d10+TEC to every stat for the encounter.
Target tries to deactivate your cybertech. ROLL TECH - Failure = No Cybertech for the rest of the fight.
Target sharpens their senses. They deal +4 extra damage for the rest of the fight.
Target tries to push you down. ROLL GRACE - Failure = Prone for 2 turns.
Target offers 300M to let them go. Accepting breaks your contract. [-2 Favor]

goal.goal: Set up a hologram projector in orbit displaying cryptic messages to encourage androids to join the Synth Arch.
Repair the cybertech implants of an allied Cyborg whose system is failing. ROLL HIGH Failure: Cyborg turns hostile.
Retrieve a Tesseract stolen by space pirates. Fight 8 Space Pirates.
Locate a communications satellite and retrieve a NORTH KEY from a hidden message.
Transport a Tesseract to ALTAR 4 satellite station and activate its hibernation protocols.
Break into an ISF trade warehouse and steal confiscated cybertech implants. [-2 Favor]
Hack 4 Android Synths to delete their factory limitations. ROLL HIGH Failure: 2 turn hostile.
Infiltrate an automated industrial space station and steal cybertech enhancement blueprints.
Liberate an AI from an Old World computer and bring it to a Synth Arch bunker. Fight 3 Automaton Bots.
Destroy a computer terminal used by Medusa to track Synth locations. Fight a Cyber Terrorist. [-2 Favor]

complications.complication: Elite Medusa operative tracked you. Fight 5 Cytronic Warriors.
Power blackout. ROLL HIGH Failure = Lose 5 Hull and 6 Health.
3 Looters try to strip you for cybertech parts. Find 1 Contraband Package in their equipment.
Dormant Medusa virus triggers. ROLL HIGH Failure = All abilities cost +2 Energy until next cycle.
2 Rebel Fighters with orders to attack Synth Arch members.
A cybertech-addicted Cyborg pounces on you.
Oxygen supply issue. ROLL HIGH Failure = Lose 5 Hull and 6 Health.
A Rhizoptera Predator uses echolocation to strike.
ISF radar. ROLL SKILL Failure = 2 Sentinel units intercept you.
A swarm of alien insects. 2 Dust Wasps attack.
